product_type: Multi-tenant Clinical Management SaaS & AI Voice EHR
theme_strategy: dark-mode-default (Deep Obsidian Slate #0B0F17 with crisp tactical borders and luminous indigo/cyan/emerald telemetry accents)
design_archetype: Archetype 2 + Swiss Precision: High-Performance Clinical Command Center. Eliminates visual clutter typical of legacy medical software; uses sharp cardless or 8px crisp radius, frosted HUD overlays, high-contrast typography, and live voice transcription telemetry widgets.

rules.overlines: text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-cyan-400 font-semibold

entry_surfaces./: Multi-tenant clinical command center — metric HUD & agenda overview with quick patient triage and voice action trigger
entry_surfaces./login: Branded dual-panel auth — left clinical positioning & security seal, right multi-tenant tenant-switcher + credentials form
entry_surfaces./portal/login: Patient portal gateway — clean credential or CPF/phone access with appointment confirmation preview

layout_and_grids.app_shell: 2-column layout with collapsible sidebar (w-64) + fixed glass top header (h-16) + main scrollable content area (p-6 or p-8)
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B): 4-column metric HUD (Total Pacientes, Consultas Hoje, Faturamento Mês, Tempo Médio com IA) + 8-col Agenda do Dia with 4-col Atendimentos Recentes/Ações Rápidas
layout_and_grids.medical_record_layout: 3-column split view: Column 1 (Patient Bio, Allergies, Vital Signs), Column 2 (Active SOAP/Consultation tab with AI Voice Dictation HUD + Dynamic Module like Odontograma 32-teeth or Visual Acuity Snellen chart), Column 3 (Historical Timeline & Prescriptions/Attachments)
layout_and_grids.super_admin_layout: Bento Grid with Global MRR, Active Tenants count, Tenant Health Status table (with Lock/Unlock toggle, Plan switch, Impersonation jump), and Plan tier builder/editor
layout_and_grids.marketing_campaign_layout: Split Composer: Left (Target Patient filters, Channel WhatsApp/SMS/Email, Template tags like {nome_paciente}), Right (Live Phone simulator preview + Disparo logs with status deliverability metrics)

states: recording (Ouvindo com onda de áudio animada)
voice_dictation_hud.features: Speech-to-text simulation with realistic medical sample transcriptions (e.g. 'Paciente relata dor no dente 16 ao mastigar', 'Acuidade visual OD 20/40 com queixa de cefaleia frontal', 'Hipertensão estágio 1, mantido Losartana 50mg'). Button to structure SOAP fields instantly via AI.

odontogram_interactive.description: Interactive 32-tooth dental chart (FDI / Universal numbering). Clinicians click any tooth (11 to 48) to assign status (Hígido, Cárie, Restauração, Extração, Canal, Prótese) and view color-coded surfaces (Vestibular, Lingual, Oclusal, Mesial, Distal).

visual_acuity_ophthalmology.description: Specialized eye-care exam widget for Snellen chart acuity (OD/OS/OU), autorefraction (Esférico, Cilíndrico, Eixo, DNP), IOP (Tonometria) and Fundus exam findings.

super_admin_panel.description: Master SaaS control for managing clinical tenants: CRUD of customizable subscription tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise with custom patient/user limits and pricing), Global Clinic tenant list, Inadimplente lock/unlock switch, and global billing metrics.

rbac_team_management.description: Granular checkbox-based permissions matrix for Clinic Staff (Roles: Admin da Clínica, Médico/Dentista, Recepcionista, Financeiro). Permissions: 'Ver Prontuário', 'Editar Agenda', 'Disparar Campanhas', 'Acessar Financeiro', 'Excluir Pacientes'.

marketing_campaigns.description: Omnichannel blast system (WhatsApp, SMS, E-mail) for patient recall (e.g. 'Retorno semestral Odonto', 'Prevenção Glaucoma', 'Aniversariantes do Mês'). Includes live WhatsApp chat balloon preview and dispatch history table.

patient_portal.description: Patient self-service interface showing Upcoming Appointments, Past Consultations, Prescriptions/Exam downloads, and a fast 3-step 'Agendar Nova Consulta' booking modal.

media_assets.description: Doctor in clinical uniform with stethoscope for doctor avatar and clinic branding
Modern high-tech clinic suite for clinic profile cover and patient portal header

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Strict Multi-Tenancy Simulation: In the mock state or backend schema, ensure every patient, appointment, record, and campaign is bound to a 'tenant_id' (e.g. 'clinic-odonto-alphaville', 'clinic-oftalmo-centro', 'clinic-med-vida'). Provide a prominent Tenant Selector in the top bar for instant switching so the user can verify complete data isolation.
2. Super Admin Access: Provide a quick 'Alternar para Visão Super Admin' toggle or role badge so testers can seamlessly inspect the Super Admin billing and tenant management dashboard.

3. Voice Dictation Experience: Build a fully interactive Voice HUD inside the Medical Record (Prontuário). When the user clicks 'Gravar Voz', animate a dynamic waveform audio bar with realistic transcription simulation that automatically parses into: Queixa Principal, História da Moléstia Atual, Exame Físico/Diagnóstico, Conduta/Prescrição, e Dentes afetados ou Acuidade.

4. Specialty Modules: Build dynamic tabs inside the Prontuário for (a) Clínica Geral (SOAP padrão), (b) Odontologia (Odontograma interativo 32 dentes com status por dente), (c) Oftalmologia (Tabela de Acuidade Visual Snellen + Refração).

5. Dark Mode by Default: Set class='dark' in html tag and craft a high-contrast palette with deep slate #0B0F17, crisp borders (#1E293B), vibrant cyan/indigo accents, and clear typography in Portuguese (pt-BR).
6. Patient Portal: Add a dedicated route or view (/portal) where patients can log in or view their agenda, download simulated PDF prescriptions, and book appointments.
7. Data Test IDs: Add kebab-case 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, and status toggles for 100% test reliability.

accessibility_and_motion.wcag_compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA certified with minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text against dark surfaces
accessibility_and_motion.motion_policy: Framer Motion (motion/react) micro-interactions for tab transitions, voice HUD pulsing, and modal popups. Uses prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
